--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 18:41:                                      
                                                                              
  Legacy full-preset compatibility implementation refinement: native NIH whole
  PluginState missing accuracy_mode migrates to false; the audio admission    
  hook refuses before any missing-key migration allocation, and active/audio  
  flag changes are refused before host parameter mutation. Inactive control   
  restoration uses the existing native construction/reinitialization/PDC path.
  Tests must toggle only this flag with bands/manual choice unchanged, verify 
  actual backend support/latency notifications, then load a full old state    
  into true mode and restore manual support/latency.                          
                                                                              
  FFI uses its existing Preset-vs-Partial discriminator. Named Preset         
  envelopes default missing mode false unambiguously, including older pre-    
  placement states. Raw Partial maps only migrate when they contain the       
  complete prior canonical saved shape: all five globals (length/phase aliases
  normalized) and all six fields for every incoming band. Incomplete          
  global/block overlays and ambiguous pre-placement raw maps retain partial-  
  overlay semantics/current mode. Canonical fir_length_index/phase_mode_index 
  values must restore the saved manual choices, with old short aliases        
  retained and normalized without duplicate constructor keys.                 
  Full/modern/partial/refusal/history and actual latency regressions will     
  execute through FFI/native wrapper paths. This changes no response          
  tolerance, fixed-mode design or performance gates.
